items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Strayhorn's relationship with Duke Ellington ('he started arranging Duke's compositions... that's why Duke liked him') but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction between himself (Barney Bigard) and Strayhorn.

ctx.x: No, I don't. I think Columbus, Ohio, or somewhere around that part. Yeah, that was -- they gave him an audition and --
What was the first number that Strayhorn did with the band? Was it a Strayhorn composition or did he start arranging Duke's compositions?

I think he started arranging Duke's compositions, writing them down, because Tizol used to extract all his arrangements and it was (like) getting) too much for him, so he decided to try the kid out and he liked what he did. And they got together and they used to put two and two together and find out that he knew more about what Duke was doing. And guys were trying to pay him to tell them the secret of Duke's arranging and he wouldn't do it, and that's why Duke liked him.
